caseStudies.title: Multi-tenant Banking Platform

context.problem: Regional bank needed to launch digital banking platform for SMBs with multi-tenant architecture and regulatory compliance.

approach.architecture: Microservices with event sourcing, separate tenant databases, API-first design
approach.tradeoffs: Chose tenant-per-database over shared schema for stronger isolation despite higher operational complexity

result.businessOutcome: Enabled bank to capture SMB market segment, reduced customer acquisition cost by 40%

caseStudies.learned: Event sourcing pattern crucial for audit trails in financial services. Tenant isolation at database level worth the operational overhead.

caseStudies.title: AI-Powered Care Platform

context.problem: Healthcare startup needed HIPAA-compliant platform with AI-powered diagnosis assistance for primary care physicians.

approach.architecture: HIPAA-compliant microservices, ML pipeline with real-time inference, encrypted data at rest and in transit
approach.tradeoffs: Chose dedicated ML infrastructure over serverless for consistent latency despite higher costs

result.businessOutcome: 10x faster diagnosis workflows, 30% reduction in misdiagnosis rates

caseStudies.learned: HIPAA compliance must be built-in from day 1, not retrofitted. Clinical workflow integration more important than ML accuracy.

caseStudies.title: Global Learning Platform

context.problem: EdTech company needed to scale platform to support 1M+ concurrent users across multiple regions with personalized learning paths.

approach.architecture: Multi-region deployment with CDN, microservices with auto-scaling, personalization engine
approach.tradeoffs: Chose eventual consistency over strong consistency for better global performance

result.businessOutcome: Enabled global expansion, improved learning outcomes by 25%, reduced infrastructure costs

caseStudies.learned: Global scaling requires regional data strategy from the start. Personalization drives engagement more than content quality.
